errors.what: Connecting rod tilt has the wrong sign (rod angle is +asin(r sin(theta)/l) instead of -asin). The rod's free end C does not lie on the slider axis (y=0): it rises above the axis when the crank pin is above (theta 30-150) and drops below it when the crank pin is below (theta 210-330). Rod end is visibly detached from the piston, while the piston block itself moves correctly along x. The panel piston_x values match the analytic formula but not the drawn rod geometry.
